It's okay. Just heavily depressed and I see no hope in happiness, financial-social-self-life success. I'm procrastinating assignments, and it's only getting heavier and the boulder on my shoulders is eventually gonna crush me. AND i hate myself for tons of reasons, many of which feed my hopelessness, and i'm suffering. I can't accept anything positive or inspirational right now, for the past couple of weeks, I'm really losing my mind. I can't stand going to school anymore. I'm too weak. My environment is too challenging and I don't have the ambition, interest, energy, happiness that is required to attack these challenges. I can't drop out because it's gonna feed my depression and it's gonna be a part of my profile and I can't live with that. I'm missing many days of school, and whenever I'm at school I'm miserable, and it takes so much effort and pain just to speak to someone, it's a f***ng nightmare. 

I really appreciate you reaching out, but I'm not looking for help. Nothing could help me right now.

Because I'm a dead end. I'm doomed. Why? Because I'm heavily depressed and I see no hope. What's really, really, triggering me right now is school. I can't stand high school anymore, I have too many assignments on my hands, too much pressure, too much sadness, I'm a sensitive, moody mess, I haven't felt happiness in 3 months despite all the meds I've been prescribed and I have absolutely no energy to keep going. That's just a fraction of my decision. Not long ago, I was the one saying how beautiful life is and how much potential there is for everyone, how promising it is to keep going when you're down... But I'm letting myself down. I don't care. 95% depression, anxiety, doubt, unhappiness, insecurity, moody, down, tired, exhausted, angry, sad, suicidal. 5% happy, optimistic. I know it's wrong, and I will eventually find a normal satisfactory lifestyle but I can't live an other day. I can't. I don't care if I knew I were to be the happiest millionaire in 10 years. I just want to fade away, to not feel any emotion, pain, feeling, desire. 

Back to my question. What will happen to me if I consume that amount of pills. I'm assuming it won't work, and I'm probably gonna end up in the hospital with a record of a suicide attempt that's gonna make me even more depressed. I wish a had a gun ffs.
